summary: Backend-only testing for Sports Trivia Blitz. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/ covering all 7 requested behaviors. 12/13 tests PASS. The single failure is /api/quiz/generate returning 502 due to the Emergent LLM key hitting its budget cap (`Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0022365, Max budget: 0.001` in backend logs) — this is a key/budget issue, not a code bug. Handler code path is correct.

critical.issue: LLM call fails with LiteLLM BadRequestError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0022365, Max budget: 0.001'. Backend correctly returns 502 'Failed to generate questions' via try/except. Requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY with higher/refreshed budget. Validation branch (400 for invalid sport/difficulty) works correctly.

action_items: Refresh/replace EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env — current key has $0.001 budget cap that is already exceeded, blocking /api/quiz/generate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 299-line file — acceptable size, well-structured.
get_current_user correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection ({'_id': 0}) on all reads.
Session expiry handling correctly normalizes tzinfo before comparison (line 82-84).
TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at is created on startup — good.
Quiz submit uses $inc + $set atomically — safe for concurrent submissions of different sports.
Minor: /quiz/generate accepts count but silently clamps to [3,10]; consider returning 400 for out-of-range values or documenting behavior.
Minor: /auth/session trusts data['email'] and data['session_token'] from Emergent OAuth response without KeyError handling — could 500 on malformed upstream response (acceptable for MVP).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test user + session inserted via pytest session-scoped fixture (test_user); auto-cleaned in teardown. All docs prefixed TEST_ (user_TEST_*, TEST_*@example.com, TEST_sess_*). No production/seed data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py — conftest.py auto-creates a test user + valid session in MongoDB and yields auth_headers fixture (Bearer <session_token>). BASE_URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (in /app/frontend/.env). Only outstanding failure is TestQuizGenerate::test_generates_questions, which depends on a working Emergent LLM key with sufficient budget. All other endpoints (root, sports, auth-gate 401 matrix, auth/me, quiz/submit + persistence + accumulation, leaderboard shape + me entry) are verified passing.
rca_of_issue: RCA for /api/quiz/generate 502: In backend.err.log — `ERROR:server:Quiz generation failed: Failed to generate chat completion: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0022365, Max budget: 0.001`. The Emergent LLM key configured in /app/backend/.env has a $0.001 budget which has been exhausted by prior calls (including E1's standalone verification). The server code catches the exception and returns 502 as designed. Reproduction: POST /api/quiz/generate with valid auth + valid sport/difficulty. Mitigation: rotate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY or raise budget on current key; no code changes needed.
